scope: Local OimoBBS decoder only; fixed frames and fresh owned output, one core and no extra workers/cache. No browser/WAN/full HTTP/posting/deployment claim.

trial_decisions.packed: Rejected: no improvement from packing FSE cell into uint32
trial_decisions.length: Rejected: small-code wrappers worsened large frames
trial_decisions.specialized: Adopted: remove length-kind branch; literal calculation is inlined by Go1.27.3. Large frame gain not established.

baseline_method: Decoder sources from clean HEAD 9f49679; same tracked benchmarks as final. New test only adds RFC length-code vectors.

validation.fixed_code_vectors: all 36 literal and 53 match codes match RFC 8878 tables 16 and 17
validation.frame_comparison: 25 frames match original bytes, independent Go decoder and libzstd; compressed inputs unchanged
validation.designcheck: 85 Markdown files, 91 JSON files, 738 local links and synthetic format checks passed
